info.scriptSrcText: property this, radians, thisFrame, segList, quadList, skewAngle, skewOffsetglobal gPausedon beginSprite  radians = float(180 / PI)  this = sprite(the currentSpriteNum)  thisFrame = 1  segList = []  repeat with i = 0 to 5    segList.add(sprite(the currentSpriteNum + i))  end repeat  quadList = []  repeat with i = 1 to 6    tempQuadList = [point(0, 0), point(200, 0), point(100, 100), point(0, 100)]    quadList.add(tempQuadList)  end repeat  repeat with i = 1 to 6    quadList[i][1].locV = (i - 1) * 55    quadList[i][2].locV = (i - 1) * 55    quadList[i][3].locV = i * 55    quadList[i][4].locV = i * 55    sprite(the currentSpriteNum + i - 1).locZ = 2    segList[i].quad = quadList[i]  end repeat  sprite(the currentSpriteNum + 6).locZ = 900  skewAngle = 100  skewOffset = 0endon exitFrame  if gPaused = 0 then    thisFrame = thisFrame - 1    if thisFrame < 1 then      thisFrame = 20    end if    curveOffset = 300    skewAngle = skewAngle + 0.0005    if skewAngle > 360 then      skewAngle = skewAngle - 360    end if    skewOffset = 0    repeat with i = 1 to 6      quadList[i][1].locH = 256 - (curveOffset + 30) + skewOffset      quadList[i][2].locH = 256 + (curveOffset + 30) + skewOffset      curveOffset = curveOffset * 0.59999999999999998      skewOffset = 80 * cos((skewAngle + ((i - 1) * 60)) * radians)      quadList[i][3].locH = 256 + (curveOffset + 30) + skewOffset      quadList[i][4].locH = 256 - (curveOffset + 30) + skewOffset      segList[i].memberNum = 88 + thisFrame      segList[i].quad = quadList[i]    end repeat  end ifend
info.name: Tornado
